method: One held trial per tool/cost with at least four real dabs, crossing the connected px/py charts. Normal /, fixed saved v3 fixture, native mouse, three repeats/tool/cost (one in quick or sustained check). Cropped decoded terrain pixels in compositor PNG, pointer/preview overlays hidden. DOM-down to visible changed pixels includes capture overhead and is not photons. Mobile: Pixel7 layout + 4x page-main-thread throttling on desktop; not a physical phone or worker/GPU throttle. Stage rings and frame/input/trace bounds are explicit.
